correctness.rationale: Conditional on the complete environment, distinct particle coordinates are independent centered Gaussians with shared random variance V. Its PDMP generator yields the first two conditional stationary moments. The affine two-state expectation semigroup gives rational Laplace denominator (z+2r)(z+lambda_-)(z+lambda_+), with lambda_-=2k+r-sqrt(r^2+4h^2). The stationary carré-du-champ identities yield C'(0+)=0,C''(0+)=-E f_S(V)^2<0 and C'''(0+)=8rh^2 E V^2>0, giving even |t|^3 cusp. At r=k-h^2/k the poles collide and evaluated nonzero numerator gives t exp(-2rt). The exact derivative ratio J=2(k+r)+4h^2/(2k+r) has derivative 2-4h^2/(2k+r)^2>0. Independently reconstructed SymPy moment identities and 16 numerical finite-lag matrix-semigroup cases. Applicable to exact ideal stationary model only; no finite-sample identifiability guarantee.

value.rationale: Cross-particle fourth-order correlations reveal common environmental fluctuations invisible in ordinary cross-particle position covariance. An exact relaxation-mode crossover and a parameter-inference invariant are natural model-specific dynamical diagnostics, beyond the equal-time covariance already known.

final_claim: For the symmetric two-state switching harmonic Brownian gas with k>h>0, r,D>0, the stationary cross-particle squared-position covariance has a |t|^3 cusp, an explicit Laplace transform, a sharp slowest-mode exchange at r=k-h^2/k with a nonzero double-pole t exp(-2rt) at collision, and a diffusion-free short-lag inverse of r.
